statement.p:
A pizza parlor offers 8 toppings.
How many 4-topping pizzas could they put on their menu? Assume double toppings are not allowed.
How many total pizzas are possible, with between zero and 8 toppings (but not double toppings) allowed?
The pizza parlor will list the 8 toppings in two equal-sized columns on their menu. How many ways can they arrange the toppings in the left column?

li.p: {8 \choose 4} = {70} pizzas. We must choose (in no particular order) 4 out of the 8 toppings.
2^{8} = {256} pizzas. Say yes or no to each topping.
P(8,4) = {1680} ways. Assign each of the 4 spots in the left column to a unique pizza topping.
